{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Convert 'revenue' column to float, coercing errors to NaN
df['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(df['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Filter for completed orders and loyal customers
df_loyal_completed = df[(df['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') & (df['status'] == 'completed')]

# Compute the mean revenue, dropping any NaN values in revenue
df_loyal_completed['revenue'].dropna().mean()"}
